hunks.baseline: There is a reason people say that while some Hunters do not drink, there are none who cannot.

hunks.baseline: Well, there was one here.
hunks.sol: Well, apparently there was one.

hunks.baseline: Miss Song’s eyes had already gone half-glazed as she furiously shook her empty glass.
hunks.sol: Miss Song’s eyes were already half-glazed as she shook her empty glass furiously.

hunks.baseline: I looked at Miss Song with concern.
hunks.sol: I watched her with concern.

hunks.baseline: *She must have drunk too quickly.*
hunks.sol: *She must’ve drunk too fast.*

hunks.baseline: The moment the drinking party had begun in earnest, she had chugged an entire bottle of soju straight from the bottle and had been like this ever since. Every now and then, she slurred incomprehensible things about someone having no damn tact and rotten luck clinging like a curse.
hunks.sol: The moment the drinking started in earnest, she’d chugged an entire bottle of soju and had been like this ever since. Every now and then, she slurred something incomprehensible about someone having no damn tact and being cursed with rotten luck.

hunks.baseline: *Is something bad going on?*
hunks.sol: *Did something bad happen to her?*

hunks.baseline: While Im Kkeokjeong was filling her glass, I leaned toward Team Leader Choi and whispered.
hunks.sol: While Im Kkeokjeong filled her glass, I leaned toward Team Leader Choi and whispered.

hunks.baseline: “……Something did happen.”
hunks.sol: “……Something did.”

hunks.baseline: “Something that happened very recently, too.”
hunks.sol: “Very recently, too.”

hunks.baseline: Miss Song’s misfortune was my misfortune. Just sitting there and watching her was breaking my heart.
hunks.sol: Miss Song’s misfortune was my misfortune. Just sitting there watching her broke my heart.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi, along with Butler Kim, who was sitting beside him, stared at me with strange expressions.
hunks.sol: Both Team Leader Choi and Butler Kim, who was sitting beside him, stared at me strangely.

hunks.baseline: It was a lukewarm answer, but that was not important right now.
hunks.sol: Their answers were oddly lukewarm, but that wasn’t important right now.

hunks.baseline: “Drink! Drink until you drop dead today!”
hunks.sol: “Drink! We’re drinking ourselves to death tonight!”

hunks.baseline: “Ha-ha-ha! This is why I really like Miss Song!”
hunks.sol: “Ha-ha-ha! This is why I like Miss Song so much!”

hunks.baseline: “It’s fine. It’s not like I’ve only known her for a day or two. That’s just how Miss Song gets when she drinks.”
hunks.sol: “She’ll be fine. It’s not like I’ve only known her for a day or two. That’s just how Miss Song gets when she drinks.”

hunks.baseline: “Even so… No, wait a second.”
hunks.sol: “Even so… Wait a second.”

hunks.baseline: I stared intently at Team Leader Choi.
hunks.sol: I fixed Team Leader Choi with a penetrating stare.

hunks.baseline: I had thought he was suspicious for a while, but now I had finally caught him.
hunks.sol: He’d seemed suspicious for a while, and now I’d finally caught him.

hunks.baseline: Was this bastard making fun of me? Did he think I was asking because I didn’t understand that?
hunks.sol: Was this bastard making fun of me? Did he think I was asking because I couldn’t figure that out?

hunks.baseline: Now that he had put it that way, I had nothing to say. When I thought about it, who was I to question the relationship between the two of them?
hunks.sol: Now that he’d put it that way, I had nothing to say. When I thought about it, who was I to question the relationship between them?

hunks.baseline: Just as I was rendered speechless, Team Leader Choi suddenly opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: Just as I found myself at a loss for words, Team Leader Choi spoke.

hunks.baseline: The name of a god who appeared in ancient Greek and Roman mythology. These days, though, it was famous for something else.
hunks.sol: The name of a god from ancient Greek and Roman mythology. These days, though, it was famous for something else.

hunks.baseline: “Who in Korea doesn’t know the Ares Guild?”
hunks.sol: “Who in Korea hasn’t heard of the Ares Guild?”

hunks.baseline: Hundreds of Guilds existed in Korea, but only one stood at the top: the Ares Guild. The achievements they had made from the early days of the Great Cataclysm to the present were too numerous to count.
hunks.sol: Hundreds of Guilds existed in Korea, but only one stood at the top: the Ares Guild. From the early days of the Great Cataclysm to the present, their achievements had been too numerous to count.

hunks.baseline: They appeared in educational comics, educational animations, movies, novels, and all kinds of other media. They had even made it into textbooks.
hunks.sol: They appeared in educational comics, animated programs, movies, novels—you name it. They’d even made it into textbooks.

hunks.baseline: The Ares Guild held a position in Korea comparable to a living King Sejong or an active General Yi Sun-sin. No, perhaps even higher.
hunks.sol: The Ares Guild’s standing in Korea was comparable to that of a living King Sejong or an active-duty Admiral Yi Sun-sin. No, it might have been even higher.

hunks.baseline: If you asked most foreigners, *Do you know King Sejong? King-God-General Yi Sun-sin?* they would probably respond, *What the hell is this Asian guy talking about?* But the Ares Guild was different.
hunks.sol: If you asked most foreigners, *Do you know King Sejong? King-God-General Yi Sun-sin?* they’d probably think, *What the hell is this Asian guy talking about?* But the Ares Guild was different.

hunks.baseline: *Oh, yeah!*
hunks.sol: *Oh, yes!*

hunks.baseline: Even a tough-as-nails Texas grandpa would tap his twin pistols and understand. That was the accepted truth among scholars.
hunks.sol: Even a tough-as-nails Texas grandpa would slap his twin pistols and know what you meant. That was the accepted academic consensus.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi swallowed a mouthful of beer before answering.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi took a sip of beer before answering.

hunks.baseline: “Because I used to be there.”
hunks.sol: “Because I used to be with them.”

hunks.baseline: I blinked for a while before finally speaking.
hunks.sol: I sat there blinking for a while before finally speaking.

hunks.baseline: “You used to belong to the Ares Guild?”
hunks.sol: “You belonged to the Ares Guild?”

hunks.baseline: “I was a Team Leader. Though I was still pretty low-ranking.”
hunks.sol: “I was a Team Leader. Though I was pretty far down the ladder.”

hunks.baseline: The Ares Guild had high standards. They selected only the best and trained them to become even better. Team Leader Choi had called himself a low-ranking member, but the fact that he had become a Team Leader there was already incredible.
hunks.sol: The Ares Guild had high standards. They selected only the best and trained them to become even better. Team Leader Choi might have called himself low-ranking, but the fact that he’d made Team Leader there was already incredible.

hunks.baseline: Though at the moment, he just looked like a lunatic to me.
hunks.sol: Though right now, he just looked like a lunatic to me.

hunks.baseline: Money, honor, and status.
hunks.sol: Money, honor, status.

hunks.baseline: It was the best job any Hunter—or any man—could dream of. And he had kicked it all away and left!
hunks.sol: It was the best job any Hunter—any man—could ever want. And he’d thrown it all away!

hunks.baseline: “Were you ostracized at work or something?”
hunks.sol: “Were you some kind of outcast at work?”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi thought about it for a moment before answering.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi considered the question for a moment before answering.

hunks.baseline: “That might have been the case. Miss Song was the only person who treated me normally.”
hunks.sol: “That might have been it. Miss Song was the only person who treated me normally.”

hunks.baseline: “She was on my team. I found out about her drinking habits during team dinners.”
hunks.sol: “She was on my team. I learned about her drinking habits at a team dinner.”

hunks.baseline: My gaze moved back and forth between Team Leader Choi, who was sipping his beer, and Miss Song, who was drinking straight from the bottle, before stopping on one person.
hunks.sol: My gaze moved between Team Leader Choi, who was sipping his beer, and Miss Song, who was drinking straight from the bottle, before settling on one person.

hunks.baseline: Butler Kim smiled kindly and waved his hand.
hunks.sol: Butler Kim smiled kindly and waved a hand.

hunks.baseline: Suddenly, I remembered the sense of incongruity I had always felt whenever I dealt with Butler Kim. I had also never once tried to assess him with my Qi Sense.
hunks.sol: I suddenly remembered the odd feeling I’d always gotten from Butler Kim—and the fact that I’d never once tried to assess him with my Qi Sense.

hunks.baseline: *What is this man’s real identity?*
hunks.sol: *Who is this man, really?*

hunks.baseline: Just as I was about to raise my Qi Sense, Im Kkeokjeong, who had been enthusiastically inhaling meat and liquor whether or not we were talking, spoke up.
hunks.sol: Just as I was about to raise my Qi Sense, Im Kkeokjeong spoke up. He’d been busily inhaling meat and liquor without paying any attention to our conversation.

hunks.baseline: “Aw, we can’t let the momentum die. Should we just eat it?”
hunks.sol: “Damn, we can’t let this kill the momentum. Should we just eat it?”

hunks.baseline: Im Kkeokjeong grumbled as he flipped a piece of meat that was still mostly raw. Butler Kim smiled gently at him.
hunks.sol: Im Kkeokjeong grumbled as he flipped a piece of meat that was still mostly raw. Butler Kim gave him a gentle smile.

hunks.baseline: The next moment, two things happened at once.
hunks.sol: Then two things happened at once.

hunks.baseline: A wave of scorching heat burst forth. Blue flames shot precisely up over the grill, heating the plate and cooking the meat in an instant before vanishing.
hunks.sol: A blast of scorching heat erupted. Blue flames surged directly over the grill, heating the plate and cooking the meat in an instant before vanishing.

hunks.baseline: Im Kkeokjeong and I shouted at the same time.
hunks.sol: Im Kkeokjeong and I shouted simultaneously.

hunks.baseline: “It’s cooked incredibly well!”
hunks.sol: “It’s cooked perfectly!”

hunks.baseline: I shook my head back and forth.
hunks.sol: I shook my head.

hunks.baseline: More importantly, who would have thought Butler Kim was a mage? No wonder something about him had always felt strange.
hunks.sol: More importantly, who would’ve guessed Butler Kim was a mage? No wonder something about him had always felt strange.

hunks.baseline: “You really fooled me.”
hunks.sol: “You really had me fooled.”

hunks.baseline: Butler Kim picked up a well-cooked piece of meat.
hunks.sol: Butler Kim picked up a perfectly cooked piece of meat.

hunks.baseline: “I had no intention of fooling you. As I told you, I’m already a retired has-been.”
hunks.sol: “I never meant to deceive you. As I said, I’m just a retired has-been.”

hunks.baseline: If Butler Kim was a has-been, half the mages still active today ought to bow their damn heads.
hunks.sol: If Butler Kim was a has-been, half the mages still active today ought to plant their heads on the floor.

hunks.baseline: He could summon flames with a single snap of his fingers and control them precisely enough to cook the meat just right without burning or undercooking it. Judging from the circumstances, he had probably belonged to the Ares Guild as well before retiring.
hunks.sol: He could summon flames with a single snap of his fingers, and his control was precise enough to cook the meat perfectly without burning it or leaving it underdone. Judging by the circumstances, he’d probably belonged to the Ares Guild before retiring.

hunks.baseline: If he had been active during the Great Cataclysm, too…
hunks.sol: And if he’d been active during the Great Cataclysm…

hunks.baseline: And on top of that, he was an incredibly senior one.
hunks.sol: On top of that, he was an incredibly senior one.

hunks.baseline: I asked cautiously.
“Um, which Hunter training center did you graduate from?”
hunks.sol: I asked cautiously, “Um, which Hunter training center did you go through?”

hunks.baseline: “Really? What a coincidence. I was in the 28th Regiment, 1st Battalion too. Which company were you in?”
hunks.sol: “Really? What a coincidence. I was in the 28th Regiment, 1st Battalion too. Which company?”

hunks.baseline: “Then it wasn’t a coincidence. I suppose it was fate. Ha-ha.”
hunks.sol: “Then perhaps it isn’t a coincidence but fate. Ha-ha.”

hunks.baseline: There was no need for further discussion. I stood up and bent deeply at the waist.
hunks.sol: There was nothing more to discuss. I rose from my seat and bowed deeply at the waist.

hunks.baseline: “Nice to meet you, Senior.”
hunks.sol: “It’s an honor to meet you, Senior.”

hunks.baseline: There is a saying in Korea about school ties, hometown ties, and blood ties.[^2] Hunters were no different.
hunks.sol: There’s a saying in Korea about school ties, regional ties, and blood ties.[^2] Hunters were no different.

hunks.baseline: The probability of awakening was 0.1 percent—one in a thousand. Because the odds were so slim, it was rare for someone you knew from ordinary society to awaken. The Hunter training center, which might seem like nothing special, was where a Hunter’s network began.
hunks.sol: The chance of awakening was 0.1 percent—one in a thousand. With odds that slim, it was rare for anyone you knew from ordinary life to awaken. The Hunter training center might not seem like much, but it was where a Hunter’s network began.

hunks.baseline: “You don’t have to go that far. Please, sit down.”
hunks.sol: “You don’t have to go this far. Please, sit down.”

hunks.baseline: “You can speak comfortably with me.”
hunks.sol: “You can speak casually with me.”

hunks.baseline: Just as Butler Kim and I were creating a warm senior-junior atmosphere, Team Leader Choi suddenly cut in.
hunks.sol: Just as Butler Kim and I were basking in the warm camaraderie between Senior and junior, Team Leader Choi suddenly cut in.

hunks.baseline: “Butler Kim. Why don’t you do as Mr. Jin says?”
hunks.sol: “Butler Kim. Why don’t you do as Mr. Jin asks?”

hunks.baseline: *What an ill-mannered bastard. How dare he tell such a senior what to do…*
hunks.sol: *What an ill-mannered bastard. How dare he tell such a distinguished Senior what to do…*

hunks.baseline: *Hmm. He can do that.*
hunks.sol: *Hmm. I guess he can.*

hunks.baseline: Come to think of it, Team Leader Choi was the bigger shot. He employed a mage from the Ares Guild as his butler.
hunks.sol: Come to think of it, Team Leader Choi was the bigger shot. He employed a former Ares Guild mage as his butler.

hunks.baseline: As my curiosity continued to grow, Team Leader Choi went on.
hunks.sol: As my curiosity grew, Team Leader Choi continued.

hunks.baseline: “I think it’s time we sorted out everyone’s forms of address. You’re the face of our Guild, after all. We can’t keep calling you Butler Kim or Uncle forever, can we?”
hunks.sol: “I think it’s time we settled how everyone should address one another. You’re the face of our Guild, after all. We can’t keep calling you Butler Kim or Uncle forever, can we?”

hunks.baseline: Butler Kim considered it for a moment before answering.
hunks.sol: Butler Kim considered this for a moment before answering.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi nodded and swept his stern gaze over everyone present.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi nodded and swept a stern gaze over everyone present.

hunks.baseline: “Man, this meat is incredible. Is it because it was grilled with magic?”
hunks.sol: “Damn, this meat is incredible. Is it because it was grilled with magic?”

hunks.baseline: “The booze is going in. Booze! Down it goes, down it goes!”
hunks.sol: “The booze goes down! Booze! Down it goes, down it goes!”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi gazed at the two of them with regret before turning his eyes toward me. I had raised one arm conspicuously.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi gazed at them with regret before turning to me. I had conspicuously raised one arm.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi spoke with an expression that seemed to say as much.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi’s expression seemed to say exactly that.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi wore an expression as if he had been betrayed, then pulled something from inside his coat and handed it to me. I took it and looked at it. It was a business card.
hunks.sol: Looking utterly betrayed, Team Leader Choi pulled something from inside his coat and handed it to me. I took it and examined it.
It was a business card.

hunks.baseline: I didn’t know whether Butler Kim was a boss in name only or merely a figurehead, but I nodded anyway. If I didn’t, Team Leader Choi looked like he might cry.
hunks.sol: I didn’t know whether Butler Kim was merely a boss in name or a public figurehead, but I nodded anyway.
